profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer and Architect
profile.summary: Results-driven Software Engineering leader with 15+ years of experience designing, developing, and implementing scalable software solutions. Deep expertise in distributed systems and microservices design patterns on Cloud and Hosted environments. Proven track record of leading teams to deliver high-quality products on time and within budget. Seeking a challenging role where I can leverage my technology and leadership skills to drive innovation and contribute to organizational success.

positions.locationName: 3 Ravinia Drive, Floor 5, Atlanta, GA 30346 USA · Hybrid

positions.title: Principal Software Architect (DIR)
positions.description:
KORE is a pioneer and leader on the Internet of Things (IoT) space. KORE brings IoT to life for our customers by helping them Deploy, Manage and Scale their IoT Solutions. 

Key achievements
• Led the Software Architecture team in designing, documenting, and implementing a transformative microservices streaming platform that significantly enhanced the company's market dominance. This scalable, redundant, and cloud-agnostic architecture leveraged modern open-source technologies, optimizing performance, availability, and cost-efficiency. Introduced data and event stream services patterns using containerization with Kubernetes and Kafka streaming platform, strategically migrating big data and time-series data to Cassandra, Elastic Search, and ClickHouse for optimized scalability and performance. The resulting platform was 30% more performant and much more resilient resulting in ~30% reduction in customer related issues
• Successfully deployed the solution on AWS and developed a comprehensive plan for future deployment on GCP, ensuring flexibility and future-proofing the company's infrastructure. This proactive approach demonstrates foresight and strategic thinking, positioning the company for continued growth and scalability in an ever-evolving technological landscape.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer/Architect Team Lead
positions.description: • Created a completely new data streaming architecture through a successful migration from a monolithic architecture constrained by a single database (MSSQL) and large applications, resulting in a dramatic improvement in performance and scalability. The system now seamlessly processes millions of records per minute, eliminating previous bottlenecks and delays that impacted customer experience. Downtimes were reduced, and overall operational costs were significantly decreased.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer Team Lead
positions.description:
Position Logic (LBS) was a leading platform on the Internet of Things (IoT) sector, specializing in fleet tracking, sensor monitoring, device management, and reporting solutions. With an extensive library of over 300 GPS device integrations, it stood out as one of the fastest-growing GPS tracking platforms in the market. The platform's user-friendly interface and seamless integration capabilities made it a preferred choice for businesses seeking efficient and reliable IoT management tools. Position Logic's success and potential were recognized through its acquisition by Raco Wireless, which was later acquired by Kore Wireless.

Key achievements
• Spearheaded the expansion of the device integration library from a limited selection to over 300, significantly increasing platform versatility and market reach. Successfully led the device integration team to achieve this remarkable growth, demonstrating strong technical leadership and project management skills.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: • Implemented device integration standardization, streamlining the onboarding process for new devices and improving overall system maintainability. This initiative enhanced development efficiency and reduced integration complexity, contributing to faster time-to-market for new features and services.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
CENATAV is a Center guided to the theoretical and applied investigations in Pattern Recognition and Data Mining. The investigations include digital images and signals processing, structural syntactic recognition, the conceptual interpretation of space data, text mining, among others.

Key achievements
• Developed an innovative incremental nested partition algorithm that leverages the strengths of multiple partitioning criteria to uncover hierarchical structures within data. Demonstrated the algorithm's effectiveness by clustering web news and document datasets, showcasing its ability to handle dynamic and diverse data sources.

publications.title: An incremental nested partition method for data clustering
